About the Job

We are the number one dating affiliate business in the world, and this role sits at the center of it. You will run paid social for the dating vertical together with our media buying lead.

This is a creative-first role. Around 60% of your time goes into thinking up angles, writing advertorials and producing ads - because in a business without a product catalog, the creative is the product. The rest is buying, funnel building and automating redundant tasks. 

This is not e-commerce: no stores, no catalogs, no supply constraints.

We are AI-native: using frontier models is how we produce and test at a volume a normal team cannot match, and we expect you to push that further than we have.

Build the creative: ad angles, hooks, advertorials and full ad concepts - researched from the customer's problem, produced with your own hands and with AI, and shipped as a constant flow of tests.

Own campaigns end to end on Meta: structure, budget allocation, scaling, account health and compliance - and you make the kill, keep or scale call yourself.

Designcomplete funnels from scratch: pre-landers, advertorials and landing pages, AI-assisted, without waiting for a designer or a developer.

Automate redundant tasks: creative variations, reporting, competitor monitoring and campaign routines, with Claude Code and agentic tooling as a daily driver, not as a gimmick.

description:

summary: Wir stellen uns dir vor.  Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Was wie eine klassische mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Rechtsanwaltsgesellschaft klingen…
description:
Wir stellen uns dir vor. 
Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Was wie eine klassische mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Rechtsanwaltsgesellschaft klingen mag, ist bei genauerem Betrachten vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir sehen den Menschen vor den Zahlen, denken und handeln fortschrittlich und arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, uns als Kanzlei und Arbeitgeber sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln. 
Dass wir dafür auch einen Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) suchen, mag für eine Steuerkanzlei zunächst ungewöhnlich erscheinen. Für uns ist es allerdings der nächste logische Schritt. Schließlich möchten wir die Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei aktiv vorantreiben, bestehende Prozesse verbessern und neue technische Möglichkeiten im Bereich KI sinnvoll in unseren Arbeitsalltag integrieren. 
Wenn du Freude daran hast, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, digitale Anwendungen weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. 
Natürlich sind auch wir nicht perfekt. Wir geben jedoch jeden Tag unser Bestes, um für dich einen optimalen Arbeitsort zu schaffen. 
Dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil. 
Du interessierst dich für IT und möchtest mit deiner Arbeit tatsächlich etwas bewegen? Bei uns kannst du die technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Kanzlei aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass digitale Anwendungen im Arbeitsalltag reibungslos funktionieren. description:
Die Renergo entwickelt bundesweit große PV-Freiflächen, Windparks und Batteriespeicher (BESS) – und geht als unabhängiger Stromerzeuger (IPP) nun den nächsten Schritt: vom reinen Projektentwickler zum Betreiber eigener Anlagen.

Für den weiteren Ausbau unserer Projektpipeline suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Flächen sichert und vor Ort Vertrauen aufbaut. Du bist das Gesicht von Renergo in deiner Region und arbeitest in einem dezentralen Team von rund 20 Menschen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Aufgaben

Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Flächen für PV-Freiflächen mit Batteriespeichern (co-located), Standalone-Batteriespeicher und Windprojekte mit unserem WebGIS-Tool

Aufbau und Pflege von Kontakten zu Grundstückseigentümern und Landwirten

Eigenständige Verhandlung von Flächennutzungsverträgen bis zum Abschluss

Ansprache von Kommunen, Gemeinderäten und kommunalen Interessenvertretern sowie Aufbau eines regionalen Netzwerks

Präsentation unserer Projekte auf Informationsveranstaltungen, Gemeinderatssitzungen und Eigentümerversammlungen

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Projektmanagement bei der Übergabe in die Entwicklung

Qualifikation

Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium und hast bereits erfolgreiche Vertriebserfahrungen gesammelt

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Flächenakquise, im Vertrieb oder in der Projektentwicklung Erneuerbarer Energien

description:
About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath…

description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

Position Summary: 

Quotient is seeking a highly analytical and scientifically curious Senior Analyst to support strategic decision-making across our growing drug development pipeline. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of analytics, market intelligence, commercial strategy and early drug development in a genetics-based biotech company. 

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and familiarity with scientific and clinical data with commercial curiosity, to turn networks of complex data into meaningful insights. In doing so, the successful candidate will help us better understand where high-value, tractable drug development opportunities exist across our internal pipeline of drug targets, and more broadly across a range of disease areas. Together with other members of the drug development team, this role will help focus which indications, patient segments, and development paths we should consider, and where data can help inform our investment and planning decisions.

This role could be based in our UK or US office and will report to the Chief Development Officer.

Across a range of disease/therapeutic areas, build a deep understanding of addressable markets, industry landscape, customer (health care practitioner, payor, and patient) needs, and forecast future states and opportunities for growth in sectors of interest

Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.
No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.
What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.
And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

The Job
Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.
Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

Ship tools people use: build tax tools on live financial data, from first idea to everyday use.

Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve.

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

To support this growth, we are expanding our team into the regional areas to meet the increasing demands of the intermediary market.

Originating, structuring, and progressing bridging applications from Introducers and Borrowers, from initial enquiry through to completion.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

About Proxima
Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.
Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.
In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

About PolarGrid
PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.
The role
You will own the routing layer: the service that decides which GPU serves each request. You will build it, run it in production and set its technical direction.
This is a hands-on staff role. Most of your time goes to designing and writing the router and the placement logic behind it. You will work closely with the engineers who run our network and our GPU sites, and you will help hire the engineers who join you.
The work
Every request has to land on a GPU that is healthy, has room and is close enough to be fast. The hard part is that capacity and health change constantly across many sites, and the router has to make good decisions quickly with information that is always slightly out of date. It also has to fail safely: when a site or server goes down, traffic moves without customers noticing.
What you bring

Deep knowledge of how networks, proxies and load balancers work underneath, from building or running production systems.

Strong distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, failure handling, retries and backpressure.

You write production code in a systems language such as Go or Rust.

You measure latency at the tail, not just the average, and know how to find where it comes from.

Estamos ampliando nuestra red de Touchers (researchers- recruiters freelance).
¿Qué buscamos?
Expertos en diferentes industrias y sectores, que quieran ser partícipes de un nuevo modelo de scouting y reclutamiento.
En nuestro modelo hemos decidido darle al cliente la opción de elegir. Y de combinar.
El cliente decide cuántos candidatos quiere ver y en qué plazo de tiempo. Sin preocuparse de más.
Por este motivo TinT surge como un concepto revolucionario, una forma de hacer reclutamiento y resolver procesos de selección de manera práctica, sencilla y cómoda.
Y que da resultados. Buenísimos resultados.
¿Por qué? porque no lo hacemos con máquinas.
Porque el motor son personas. Gente muy buena en lo suyo, gente como tú.
El corazón de todo esto son nuestros Touchers (recruiters en la vida normal), que colaboran en modalidad freelance y forman nuestro equipo.
Sin embargo, la libertad es para nosotros un principio básico y por ello eres libre de:

Elegir cuánto tiempo nos quieres dedicar.

Elegir cuánto quieres ganar en base al volumen de proyectos que quieres/puedes abordar.

Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement, both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move.
H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents, fully managed agents that take actions on computers.

What you own
Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA.

What you'd be doing
Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers.

Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten?

Dit is jouw uitdaging
Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG).
Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen.
Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid.
Je onderzoekt onder andere:
Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties?

Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG?

Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen?

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll set technical direction across these layers and stay…

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Money Management products (Financial Accounts, Treasury, Global Payouts, Issuing, and Capital) let businesses and platforms hold, move, spend, and earn on their money using the same infrastructure they already use for payments. APAC Money as a Service (MaaS) is a newly formed team, based in Singapore, responsible for bringing this product suite to Asia-Pacific markets, enabling global businesses and platforms to use these capabilities directly or offer them to their APAC users, and building the local rails, compliance, and partner integrations that make it all work.

None of this works without financial partners: the banks, card networks, and licensed institutions whose systems our products run on in each market. Technical Operations in APAC MaaS owns the day-to-day health of those partner integrations, existing and new, and the working technical relationship with the partners behind them. Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact…

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

summary: Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a…
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Figma is building the system of record for digital product development: collaborative tools with natural interfaces that bring PMs, developers, QA, and designers together. That creates new-to-the-world problems in how we build AI products, understand how people use them, and evaluate what makes them useful. You'll work with a unique, petabyte-scale dataset with rich traces of collaborative design and product building to tackle those problems. We're looking for an Applied Data Researcher who combines scientific depth with a proactive builder mindset. Reporting directly to our Head of Data, with regular visibility with C-level executives, you'll identify and vet opportunities, lead investigations into critical questions, and build useful Data products, tools, and prototypes. You'll work across Data Science, Engineering, Product, Design, and AI Research, building directly and providing technical direction to teams of other scientists as efforts grow.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of…

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.
